text:
emma: HelioSys RFP landed. They want a 3-week on-prem POC, EU-only data, HSM BYOK, and a capability matrix for 4-bit quant chat. can we scope timelines + pricing?

raj: we can do slim-runtime with q4 variants and offline mode. recommend a dedicated pod + trimmed control plane image for the POC. estimate 2 engineer-days for setup, 1 engineer-day remote support during run.

emma: nice. can you drop a one-page capability CSV I can send?

raj: pasted CSV:
```
feature,supported,notes
offline_mode,yes,telemetry disabled; logs local
4-bit_quant,yes,validated q4_0/q4_k variants; perf varies
hsm_byok,yes,KMIP + vendor adapter
eu_data_residency,yes,pinned region for control plane and storage
dedicated_pod,yes,1x pod reserved for 3 weeks
support,remote,2 setup days + 1 day during POC
```

olivia: legal flags: need NDA + DPA addendum. if BYOK/HSM, require vendor attestation and key rotation plan. I'll draft simple DPA and list required vendor docs.

emma: pricing options for procurement (simple lines): hosted-metered, dedicated-short reserve, or appliance license. back-of-envelope numbers pls.

raj: quick numbers:
- Hosted (metered): ~$2,800/month for the throughput profile (variable).
- Dedicated 3-week reserve: ~$7,500 upfront (includes reserved pod + infra) + $1k for integration support.
- Appliance license (one-time): $10k + $3k integration.
Assumptions: 150 req/min avg, 350 tokens/req, open model quantized.

billing-bot: Invoice sample queued for dedicated option. Template ID: INV-POC-342. Contact procurement for billing contact.

deploy-bot: Demo env requested (env-POC-2026). Slim image tag: redwood/slim:2026-03-edge. ETA ~1.5h. Note offline flag set.

emma: perfect. I'll send the RFP reply tomorrow 09:00 CET with CSV, legal checklist, runbook snippet, and pricing. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

raj: runbook snippet to paste in packet:
```
# VPC peering quick check
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://env.internal.redwood/env-POC-2026/health
```

olivia: dropping DPA draft into Drive and will ping procurement: procurement@heliosys.example.

emma: closing loop - will update thread if deployment shows any blockers.
